text:
frank: heads-up: while onboarding helios-20b int8 we hit a deterministic divergence vs fp16 when the running context crosses the 48k boundary (49152 tokens). minimal repro attached.

maya: oof. exact error?

frank: run on a single V100, seed=123, seq=49200. log snippet:
```
ERR: rope_phase_mismatch at global_pos 49152 (layer=14): expected 0x3c21, got 0x3c23
INFO: prefill flush at 49152, kv_phys_idx=49160, kv_logical_idx=49152
WARN: applied ropescale with adjusted base on phys_idx >= 49152
```

otto: that phys vs logical idx mismatch looks like a pad/alignment issue. we added `pack_tile_pad=8` to improve memcpy vectorization in int8 path last month. did helios hit a new shard boundary?

ciara: quick check: `--no-cache` makes outputs identical to fp16. with cache enabled mismatch is 100% at the same token. reproducible across GPUs.

kv-bot: test-run: 1792223340 by frank — helios-20b / int8 / cuda:0 / seq=49200 / dump-kv=1. Result: mismatch at layer=14, kv_phys_idx=49160, pad=8.

maya: that means our rotary math is using logical positions but the kernel saw padded buffer positions. possible fixes: (A) compute logical_pos = phys_pos - pad_offset where ropescale applied, or (B) store a separate logical-index array passed into rotary kernel. Option A is simpler.

frank: agreed. i reproduced in a tiny unit test: tests/longctx/test_kv_shard_wrap.py — fills 50k tokens and compares per-layer rope phase between int8 and fp16. failing assertion at layer 14, pos 49152. i'll push the failing test in a draft PR.

otto: bisect results: commit 5b7d2a introduced pack_tile_pad in runtime/pack.cc — older commit 5b7d29 doesn't show the issue. linking bisect: https://ci/repo/bisect/5b7d2a..5b7d29

ciara: short mitigation for Private/on-prem: runtime config `pack_tile_pad=0` reverts to contiguous layout and avoids the regression (perf hit ~2-3%). we should document that as a temporary flag.

maya: long-term: either adjust rotary index computation to subtract cumulative pad per-layer, or avoid changing physical indices exposed to the attention kernel. i prefer fixing index math in pack/rope glue so packed kernels get correct logical positions.

frank: plan: frank to open PR with failing unit test + repro logs, otto to prototype small fix in runtime/rotary.cc that computes logical_pos = phys_pos - pad_prefix[layer], ciara to add nightly eval comparing helios int8 vs fp16 at windows [8k,32k,48k,64k].

kv-bot: task created ENGML-3001 — failing test + bisect notes; ENGML-3002 — patch rotary index calc; ENGML-3003 — nightly long-window evals for quant models.

otto: prototype patch looks good locally: subtract pad_prefix before computing ropescale; added assert that logical_pos >= 0. runs green on unit and reproducer. will open PR.

ciara: once PR lands, i'll run a quick LLMQA sweep (long-window set) and a token-level diff across the dump to ensure no hidden off-by-one shifts. if drift > 1% on LLMQA we revert.

frank: thanks. adding note to quant onboarding checklist: run longctx cross-shard tests at >=48k for any model with packed kernels. saves future support tickets. :memo:
